schema.outputs: float64 [N, d] transmitted features, or int64 [N] command codes 0..C-1
schema.day: int64 [N] recording day in time order (labels in each export's days)
schema.segment: int64 [N] disjoint part of a day (labels in each export's segments)
schema.order: int64 [N] 0-based position in time within user and day among exported rows
schema.target: int64 [N] cue: 0 = left hand, 1 = right hand
schema.C: int64 scalar, commands only: declared alphabet size, 3

trial_keys_schema.file: {export stem}.trials.csv next to each export; row i describes row i of the export

columns.order: export order (renumbered after filtering, so not a cross-stream key)

trial_keys_schema.join: put two exports of a cohort on common trial support by joining on (user, source_session, source_run, source_trial), never on (user, day, order)

source_session.bnci2014_001: B's session label T or E; run and trial as stored in artifacts/exp_b/final/*/seed*_outputs.npz (and K's command records)
source_session.lee2019: L's metadata frame T (session 1) or E (session 2); run and trial as stored in artifacts/exp_l/outputs_*.joblib (and K's command records)
source_session.yang2025: dayN of data/processed/yang2025/dayN_subSSS.npz; run and trial = that archive's run and trial arrays

utility_definition: Deployment day(s) only, per user then mean over users (each user weight 1): task_ba = mean of the two class recalls of the argmax decision of the rung's decoder; hold_rate, correct_move_rate and wrong_move_rate = holds, moves toward the cue and moves away from it over all of the user's trials in the export.

exports.drop_rule: B's quality mask (beat.data.quality_mask): artifact-flagged and non-finite trials excluded, as in B's attacks and task figures
